_comment: Phrases that signal a pastoral leadership transition on a church website, Facebook post, or news item. weight 1-3 (3 = strong/unambiguous). status maps to apply-enrichment-round.js transition_status. Heuristic only; confirm before recording, and never guess a successor name or date.

signals.note: Common church phrase for a planned senior-pastor handoff.
Direct retirement statement.
Planned retirement.
Planned retirement.
Retirement with a near-term but unspecified date; chase the month.
Generic transition language; read for which direction.
A handoff is being arranged.
Resignation, sometimes abrupt; check for cause and date.
Resignation/step-down.
Resignation statement.
An interim is serving; the senior seat is between pastors.
Explicit interim in the senior role.
A search is underway, so the seat is open or soon to be.
Active search; seat open or in transition.
Active search; seat open or in transition.
A candidate is preaching as a nominee for the senior role.
Scheduled weekend for a senior-pastor candidate.
A named successor/candidate; record the name only if credibly stated.
A call has been extended to a successor.
A successor accepted; may be installed soon.
A successor's start is dated.
A successor is in or about to be installed; if installed, update the pastor field instead.
